features: Call Notifications on Your Finger – Stay Connected Instantly: Get real-time call alerts directly on your smart ring without checking your phone, making your daily routine smarter and more convenient.
Prayer Counter for Spiritual Tracking: Easily track your daily prayer or meditation counts with a dedicated built-in counter, combining technology with mindfulness.
Advanced Health Monitoring – Heart Rate, SpO2, HRV & Stress: Monitor your health 24/7 with accurate tracking of heart rate, blood oxygen levels, heart rate variability (HRV), and stress levels.
Auto Workout Detection & Activity Tracking: Automatically detects activities like walking and running while tracking steps, calories burned, and distance without manual input.
Sleep Tracking & Female Health Monitoring: Track deep and light sleep cycles with detailed insights, along with menstrual cycle tracking for better health management.
IP68 Waterproof & Durable Stainless Steel Design: Engineered with premium stainless steel and IP68 waterproof rating, suitable for workouts, hand washing, and daily use.
Ultra-Lightweight & Comfortable 8mm Slim Design: Designed for all-day comfort with a sleek, stylish, and lightweight build that feels natural on your finger.
Long Battery Life with Charging Case Support: Enjoy up to 5–7 days of battery life with extended standby time and easy charging support for uninterrupted usage.
Smart Gesture Control & App Connectivity: Control your smartphone, capture photos, and sync all your health data with Android & iOS apps for real-time insights.
